title: A session reads the decision that governs a case before it picks or passes on a quoted rule
why: 08:48 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 08:44 and 08:48 CST, relayed). Two slips in one hour. (1) The coordinator passed on 'never braked' as the owner's rule without reading decision machine-load-brake (the lane's paraphrase; the decision says an orchestrator's shell and file writes are never braked). (2) The coordinator picked on home #731 from the claude-settings 'Lane draft PR' grant (a lane never marks its PR ready); owner ruling Q2 in decision draft-until-reviewed, live in home, says a lane may mark ready once. The pick was withdrawn 08:48 CST. Harm it stops: a pick or a relayed rule that departs from the governing decision, sent to a lane as an order. Guard idea (not built, triage's note, the coordinator's wording): read the cited decision before a pick. Cost and the check's shape are unmeasured. Sightings: step start-checks-after-call. Triage's own earlier slip of the same family: the #3477 hold line (written without reading its PR state).
source: Coordinator 08:44 and 08:48 CST Nov 15; filed by triage.
note: Low. Ask: decide whether a check can see a pick or a relayed quote that cites a decision, and compare it to that decision's text; or leave it as a habit with two sightings. Not started.
